# Design loops

Complete searches, one call each: the per-application loops the demos run, plus the code-space stage that invents new prefetchers. Every loop runs without a model; a local model fills a named role when one is available.

## Worked example

    ```python
    from flux_chia_nodes import flux_interconnect_mapping_dse_loop

    out = flux_interconnect_mapping_dse_loop(seed=0, climb_rounds=40)
    print(out["conclusion"]["balanced_pick"])   # the knee of the 4-cost front
    ```

The NLU and the MAC array run from their problem documents (`flux task run <doc> --tui`);
the others are still demos (`applications/<name>/demo.py`). Each returns the same
decision-first record.

## bankmap_dse_loop

Find an address-to-bank mapping that is conflict-free for N concurrent accesses per stride: the plain modulo checked, the XOR-fold family searched exactly with z3 (the cheapest conflict-free fold, or a proof none exists), what IS feasible when the request is not, then non-linear mappings a local model proposes -- every one checked over the whole address space.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `strides` | `list[int]` | Access strides in words |
| `concurrent` | `int` | N accesses issued together; at most `banks`. |

??? note "12 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `banks` | `int` | `8` | B banks, a power of two. |
    | `address_bits` | `int` | `20` | The address space the guarantee must hold over. |
    | `z3_seconds` | `int` | `60` | Solver budget per attempt. |
    | `llm_round` | `int` | `6` | Mappings a local model may propose once the linear answer is known; 0 for a solver-only run. |
    | `max_xor_inputs` | `int \| None` | `None` | Hardware bound on address bits folded into one bank bit. |
    | `problem` | `str \| None` | `None` | The requirement in words, for the model. |
    | `db_path` | `str` | `'demo-bankmap.db'` | Where the study records itself. |
    | `crossbar` | `str \| None` | `None` | A staged crossbar in front of the banks |
    | `stage_capacities` | `list[int] \| None` | `None` | Accesses one stage resource carries per cycle, one per stage. |
    | `lanes` | `int \| None` | `None` | The input width of the first stage's crossbars. |
    | `stages` | `list[dict[str, Any]] \| None` | `None` | Explicit sharing points, each {"bits": [bank-index bits], "capacity": c}, for topologies a GxH layout cannot describe. |
    | `topology` | `str \| None` | `None` | The interconnect between requesters and banks, as a spec: "crossbar" (one full switch; the default), "staged:GxH" (a tree of crossbars; `lanes` and `stage_capacities` refine it), "omega" or "butterfly" (self-routed 2x2 switch networks, one conflict point per stage), "clos:n,m,r" (per-cycle routed, non-blocking when m >= n) or "benes" (non-blocking). |

## interconnect_mapping_dse_loop

Run the banked-L1 conflict study: tensor storage modes vs 32 banks, map policies crossed with twelve interconnect topologies, judged on a four-cost Pareto with proofs (docs/decisions.md D378-D383).

??? note "7 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `seed` | `int` | `0` | Workload seed; train/holdout use disjoint ranges. |
    | `ops` | `int` | `8` | MU operations per workload. |
    | `climb_rounds` | `int` | `40` | XOR tap hill-climb rounds (injectivity-gated; 0 disables). |
    | `llm_rounds` | `int` | `0` | Model-proposed hash rounds via local Ollama (0 = model-free). |
    | `llm_model` | `str \| None` | `None` | Ollama tag, or omit for the default local model. |
    | `vu_probability` | `float` | `0.7` | Chance VU traffic joins a system step (regime knob). |
    | `dma_probability` | `float` | `0.6` | Chance a DMA stream joins an operation (regime knob). |

## invent_prefetcher

Design NEW L2 cache prefetchers in C++, compile them, and measure whether they win.

??? note "13 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `rounds` | `int` | `4` | How many designs to ask for. |
    | `repair_attempts` | `int` | `3` | How many times a design that fails to compile is handed its own first compiler diagnostic and asked to fix it. |
    | `inert_repairs` | `int` | `1` | How many times a design that compiled and ran but changed nothing is handed the simulator's counters (zero prefetches issued, or none useful) and asked to fix the logic. |
    | `problem` | `str \| None` | `None` | The workload in plain language, replacing the default description of the 5G baseband traces. |
    | `traces_dir` | `str \| None` | `None` | Where the traces live. |
    | `source_tree` | `str \| None` | `None` | A ChampSim source tree to build in; otherwise the one beside the binary. |
    | `parallelism` | `int` | `12` | Simulations in flight at once. |
    | `llm_model` | `str \| None` | `None` | Override the local model. |
    | `num_predict` | `int` | `2400` | Output token budget. |
    | `scratch_root` | `str \| None` | `None` | Where to stage build trees; each candidate gets a private copy. |
    | `keep_dir` | `str \| None` | `None` | Where to write every design that compiled, with its measurements. |
    | `confirm_best` | `bool` | `True` | Re-measure the best design at full length before declaring anything. |
    | `reference_stack` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | Measure this stack as the reference instead of choosing the tallest one the library can vouch for. |

## macarray_dse_loop

Search a MAC processing element's microarchitecture on real ASAP7 silicon numbers.

??? note "19 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `db_path` | `str` | `'demo-macarray.db'` | Where measurements accumulate; a resumed run re-measures nothing. |
    | `workload` | `str \| None` | `None` | A Workload IR document (path); its einsum's precision sets the PE's. |
    | `lanes` | `int` | `8` | Products summed per cycle. |
    | `accumulate` | `bool` | `True` | Whether the PE carries an accumulator input (acc = acc_in + sum). |
    | `target_mhz` | `float \| None` | `1000.0` | The clock the PE must make; the decision is the smallest PE that does. |
    | `preserve_fmax` | `bool` | `False` | Area is the objective and the incumbent's clock the floor: the target becomes the incumbent's own measured fmax on each stage and the decision is the smallest PE that holds it. |
    | `clock_period_ps` | `float \| None` | `None` | What the tools are constrained to; default the target's period. |
    | `multipliers` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` |  |
    | `reducers` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` |  |
    | `pipelines` | `list[int] \| None` | `None` |  |
    | `mappings` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` |  |
    | `invent_rounds` | `int` | `0` | Ask the local model for N new multiplier structures; each that passes its vectors is kept and joins the menu of every later run. |
    | `include_invented` | `bool` | `True` | Offer the kept inventions. |
    | `decide_on_finalists` | `int` | `4` | How many designs, spread along the screened frontier, to place. |
    | `screen_only` | `bool` | `False` | No placement; every number is then the synthesis screen's. |
    | `workers` | `int` | `0` | Tool processes in flight at once. |
    | `problem` | `str \| None` | `None` | What is needed, in words, for the model. |
    | `llm_model` | `str \| None` | `None` | Override the local model. |
    | `seed` | `int` | `0` | Golden-vector seed. |

## nlu_dse_loop

Design an FP16 non-linear unit (exp, log, sigmoid, tanh, gelu, recip, rsqrt) and measure it: a local model chooses the computation method per operator (LUT, piecewise polynomial, interpolation, Newton-Raphson, CORDIC, ...), shared vs per-operator hardware, and combinational vs pipelined depth, and authors adversarial unit-test vectors; the gate is EXHAUSTIVE -- every operator within `ulp_budget` ULP of the FP16 reference on all 65536 inputs, or refused with the failing inputs. Survivors are screened by yosys/STA and finalists placed by OpenROAD for PPA on ASAP7.

??? note "10 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `db_path` | `str` | `'demo-nlu.db'` | The campaign record; resume re-judges its designs, keeps its authored test suite, and reads its conclusions and refusals back. |
    | `ops` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | Operator subset (default: all seven). |
    | `ulp_budget` | `int` | `1` | The correctness gate, in ULP over the whole FP16 domain. |
    | `op_steps` | `int` | `24` | Steps the loop may spend per pass; 0 re-judges the record with no model. |
    | `test_rounds` | `int` | `1` | Model test-author rounds adding adversarial vectors. |
    | `clock_period_ps` | `float` | `1250.0` | What the synthesis and placement tools are constrained to. |
    | `target_mhz` | `float \| None` | `None` | A demanded clock; the decision becomes the smallest area meeting it. |
    | `decide_on_finalists` | `int` | `3` | Frontier points placed whole for PPA. |
    | `screen_only` | `bool` | `False` | Skip placement; order by synthesis, quote nothing as PPA. |
    | `llm_model` | `str \| None` | `None` | Ollama tag for the designer (default: the repo's local model). |

## prefetcher_dse_loop

Search an L2 prefetcher's configuration space against real ChampSim traces, in two stages: maximise geomean IPC speedup over the no-prefetcher baseline, then minimise the prefetcher's hardware storage while holding a fraction of that speedup.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `db_path` | `str` | Where measurements accumulate. |

??? note "18 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `problem` | `str \| None` | `None` | Plain-language goal, replacing the default in the proposer's prompt. |
    | `traces_dir` | `str \| None` | `None` | Where the traces live (default: applications/prefetcher/traces). |
    | `champsim_bin` | `str \| None` | `None` | The simulator; otherwise $FLUX_CHAMPSIM_BIN, then PATH, then the in-tree project build. |
    | `stage` | `int` | `2` | 1 stops after maximising speedup; 2 also minimises storage. |
    | `budget` | `int` | `24` | Configurations to MEASURE per stage. |
    | `llm_round` | `int` | `8` | Configurations proposed by a local model before the search starts; 0 for a fully deterministic run. |
    | `parallelism` | `int` | `16` | Simulations in flight at once. |
    | `seed` | `int` | `0` | Seed for the sampled part of the search. |
    | `retention_floor` | `float` | `0.9` | Stage 2 must keep this fraction of stage 1's speedup. |
    | `strategy` | `str` | `'climb'` | How stage 1 spends its budget. |
    | `max_storage_bytes` | `int \| None` | `None` | A hard budget on the prefetcher's modelled storage. |
    | `decide_on_finalists` | `int` | `4` | Re-measure N configurations at full length before deciding, spread along the screened speedup-vs-storage frontier rather than the top N by speedup, so the confirmed numbers trace the trade-off instead of one corner. |
    | `screen_only` | `bool` | `False` | Skip the full-length confirmation. |
    | `compose_rounds` | `int` | `2` | Greedily add L2 partner prefetchers alongside Bingo, up to this many times, keeping each only if it earns its place. |
    | `tune_partners` | `int` | `12` | Hill-climb the partners' own knobs for this many measurements. |
    | `include_invented` | `bool` | `True` | Offer the invention loop's kept designs as partners too, on a simulator built with them installed (about a minute, cached by content). |
    | `invent_rounds` | `int` | `0` | Have the local model invent NEW prefetchers during this run, judged by the compiler and the screen; survivors join the compose menu immediately. |
    | `remote` | `bool` | `True` | Dispatch simulations as Ray tasks. |
